title: Integrated Multi-Omics and Machine Learning Identify PTTG1 as a Prognostic Biomarker and Therapeutic Target in Endometrial Cancer
summary: A Research Square preprint integrated TCGA and GEO multi-omics data with machine-learning feature selection to identify PTTG1 as a prognostic candidate in endometrial cancer. The authors report expression and protein-level checks in paired clinical specimens and CPTAC corroboration. This does not establish clinical utility or therapeutic efficacy.
ai_technology: Integrated multi-omics analysis with machine-learning prognostic modeling
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The preprint reports PTTG1 expression checks with Western blot, qRT-PCR and immunohistochemistry in paired clinical specimens, and CPTAC proteomic corroboration.
evidence.unknown: The reported specimen checks do not establish clinical utility or therapeutic efficacy; independent prospective validation is not reported.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO, SVM-RFE, XGBoost and Boruta were used for feature selection in TCGA/GEO transcriptomic analyses; single-cell and spatial transcriptomics informed localization of PTTG1.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
